tree: It started with one task: check a file out of PDM, open the assembly, act on it, check it back in. Months later, its programme covers drawing compliance against 12 in-house templates, part generation, 3D configurations and BOM generation, with clash detection and 3D norms checks next.
Nothing in its stack changed. Its data stays in its own cloud. Its engineers keep the final check; the agents do the repetitive work and flag what needs a decision.
